newsitem.title: JAPAN: Soccer-Brazil's Edilson leads Kashiwa back to J-League top.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Brazil's Edilson leads Kashiwa back to J-League top.

text.p: Brazilian forward Edilson struck home a second-half winning goal on Saturday as Kashiwa Reysol rallied to beat Iwata Jubilo 2-1 at home and get back on the winning track in a tight J-League first-stage title race.

Edilson pounced on a loose ball in a scramble in front of the goal to score his seventh goal of the season in the 71st minute after Yuji Yokoyama snatched a 19th minute equaliser to cancel out Iwata's early lead.

Kashiwa, which slipped from the top of the 17-club table with a 2-0 loss to Yokohama Flugels last weekend, now has 18 points at the head of the table from nine matches while pre-season favourite Iwata has 14 from eight.
A 37-minute header by Yasuyuki Moriyama gave Nagoya its second win this season and robbed Gamba Osaka of a win.

Moriyama met a cross from Kenji Ito for the only goal of the game as Nagoya pulled off a deserved win over a listless home side that played without suspended Cameroon striker Patrick Mboma and Yugoslav playmaker Mebojsa Krupnikovic.
Gamba Osaka slipped to third position behind Kashima which won 3-2 in a penalty shootout in an away game against Kawasaki.
The teams were tied 1-1 at half-time. Neither team added another goal, setting up the penalty shootout.
Yokohama Marinos beat Hiroshima 4-2 at home thanks to defensive lapses by the visitors.
Japanese international forward Shoji Jo played a part in all the Marinos' goals except for an eighth-minute own goal by a Hiroshima defender that gave the home side a 2-0 lead.
Midfielder Teruo Iwamoto drove home a 20-metre (66 ft) freekick in the 24th minute and Bellmare Hiratsuka went on to a 2-1 home victory over lowly Fukuoka.
Eisuke Nakanishi scored two goals before the break to lead Ichihara to a comfortable 3-0 win over visiting Cerezo Osaka.

The ninth round's most-awaited match ended in disappointment for fans when rain forced the game between Urawa and Yokohama Flugels to be cancelled in the first half. It will be played at a later date.
